policy: Required and optional edges apply only under their when condition. Current authorization, client tools and invocation restrictions remain authoritative. Do not recursively preload the graph.

ui-craft.when: Before claiming the edited UI or interaction works.
For generic-design checks before and after visual edits.
When the target is a React Native/Expo interface rather than a web page.

ui-cliche-audit.when: Only when the user also authorizes implementation of the findings.
When observed contrast, keyboard or semantic defects need a focused accessibility review.

build-sequencer.when: When an implementation task reaches verification; not for a plan-only request.
When an unresolved product choice changes the implementation.
When the user explicitly requests its spec/ticket implementation flow.
When the feature contains durable Temporal workflows.
When the requested deliverable includes Terraform modules.
When implementing a React Native/Expo feature.

bug-tracer.when: Before claiming the reproducer is fixed.
When the observed defect is a measured performance regression.
When diagnosis depends on the pinned dependency implementation.

behavior-proof.when: When verifying Python Temporal replay, timers or determinism.
When the client permits terminal browser QA and no more specific browser contract takes precedence.

diff-inspector.when: When changed documentation may disagree with implementation.
Only when a double-review procedure is explicitly requested and delegation is authorized.

mcp-server-forge.when: Before claiming the server/tool contract works.
When client registration, initialization or tool discovery needs diagnosis.
When implementing the server in Go.
When implementing a TypeScript server contract.

schema-migrator.when: Before claiming migration, compatibility or rollback success.
When a PostgreSQL migration needs real-schema query or index evidence.

ship-check.when: When the readiness assessment makes tested or runtime capability claims.
Only when the user asks to ship changes after the read-only readiness assessment.

spec-implementer.when: For the explicitly requested test-first implementation flow.
For the final code review specified by this implementation flow.
Before reporting the implementation as working.
When the spec needs an ordered acceptance plan.

branch-shipper.when: When preparing or updating the hosted PR.
When PR checks need diagnosis or an authorized wait for completion.

primary-source-notes.when: For the final source-to-claim check on the research note.
When official sources need locating or refreshing; retain the existing delegation limit.

rival-dossier.when: When finding or refreshing public competitor sources.
When the user also requests comparison-page copy from the researched profiles.
When the user also requests sales battle cards.

editorial-roadmap.when: When an approved written voice must guide the editorial plan.
When existing assets need adaptation into the planned channels.
When the requested roadmap depends on a search-content audit.

draft-reviser.when: When the revision requires changing article structure.
When an argument has evidence or coverage gaps.
When matching a supplied writing sample is requested.

story-diagnosis.when: When the diagnosed problem concerns character motivation or development.
When the diagnosed problem concerns dialogue.
When reader expectations depend on genre promises.

book-outliner.when: When the studied book needs structural interpretation beyond the scene inventory.
When turning the analysis into a multi-session craft study plan.

outline-to-chapter.when: Before delivering drafted prose; preserve the fiction voice.
When scene order or causal structure is unclear.
When a drafted scene fails the established character arc.
When a dialogue pass is needed.
When a conventional beat needs alternatives.
When the draft reaches sentence-level revision.

story-cowriter.when: Before delivering generated prose; preserve the writer's voice.
When the writer supplies a complete chapter outline.
When requested alternatives focus on dialogue.
When new material must be checked against persistent canon.

rpg-game-master.when: When a session needs tone or player-expectation calibration.
When running a persistent setting with recorded canon.
When tracking consequential changes across sessions.

world-bible.when: When checking systemic consistency across canon entries.
When the requested canon work includes constructed-language design.
When the world's evolving state needs consequence tracking.

learning-roadmap.when: When the work moves from planning to an actual tutoring session.
When an AI Hero-format course repository needs exercise folders.
When reviewing progress to adjust the roadmap.

exercise-scaffold.when: Before claiming course lint and exercise checks passed.
When exercise order needs alignment with course milestones.

rn-expo-builder.when: Before claiming mobile behavior works; honor the current client's device-tool contract.
When the feature adds login or access checks.
When list, animation or startup performance has a measured problem.

terraform-module-smith.when: Before claiming validation, plan or Terratest results.
When the module work includes authorized secret delivery or rotation.
When requested infrastructure includes Kubernetes workload artifacts.

temporal-flow-design.when: When delivering a Python Temporal implementation that needs replay/determinism proof; not for a design-only request.
When workflow evolution changes persisted application data.
When a failure or replay mismatch needs isolation.

slide-story-design.when: When a deck file must be built and the client has no preferred native presentation owner.
When slide structure needs to communicate supplied quantitative evidence.
When adapting the slide story into a spoken script.
